targets.rawSql:
SELECT start_time AS "Time", row_number() OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS "Lap", total_distance / 1609.344 AS "Distance", total_elapsed_time AS "Duration", total_elapsed_time / NULLIF(total_distance / 1609.344, 0) AS "Pace", avg_heart_rate AS "Avg HR", max_heart_rate AS "Max HR", total_ascent * 3.28084 AS "Ascent", total_descent * 3.28084 AS "Descent", (total_ascent - total_descent) * 3.28084 AS "Net elevation"
FROM garmin.fit_lap
WHERE "activityId" = ${Activity:sqlstring}
ORDER BY start_time

SELECT a."startTimeGMT" AS "Time", max(z."zoneLowBoundary") FILTER (WHERE z."zoneNumber" = 1) AS "Zone 1", max(z."zoneLowBoundary") FILTER (WHERE z."zoneNumber" = 2) AS "Zone 2", max(z."zoneLowBoundary") FILTER (WHERE z."zoneNumber" = 3) AS "Zone 3", max(z."zoneLowBoundary") FILTER (WHERE z."zoneNumber" = 4) AS "Zone 4", max(z."zoneLowBoundary") FILTER (WHERE z."zoneNumber" = 5) AS "Zone 5"
FROM garmin.activities a JOIN garmin."hrTimeInZones" z USING ("activityId")
WHERE a."activityId" = ${Activity:sqlstring}
GROUP BY a."startTimeGMT"

panels.description: The line color shows the heart rate zone. The zone limits come from the activity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "timestamp" AS "Time", extract(epoch FROM "timestamp" - (SELECT "startTimeGMT" FROM garmin.activities WHERE "activityId" = ${Activity:sqlstring})) AS "Elapsed", heart_rate AS "Heart rate"
FROM garmin.fit_record
WHERE "activityId" = ${Activity:sqlstring}
ORDER BY "timestamp"

SELECT a."startTimeGMT" AS "Time", max(z."zoneLowBoundary") FILTER (WHERE z."zoneNumber" = 1) AS "Zone 1", max(z."zoneLowBoundary") FILTER (WHERE z."zoneNumber" = 2) AS "Zone 2", max(z."zoneLowBoundary") FILTER (WHERE z."zoneNumber" = 3) AS "Zone 3", max(z."zoneLowBoundary") FILTER (WHERE z."zoneNumber" = 4) AS "Zone 4", max(z."zoneLowBoundary") FILTER (WHERE z."zoneNumber" = 5) AS "Zone 5"
FROM garmin.activities a JOIN garmin."hrTimeInZones" z USING ("activityId")
WHERE a."activityId" = ${Activity:sqlstring}
GROUP BY a."startTimeGMT"

panels.title: Heart rate

panels.description: Pace for each moment of the activity. Faster paces are higher. Moments slower than 30:00 per mile are left out. The Business Charts plugin draws it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM "timestamp" - (SELECT "startTimeGMT" FROM garmin.activities WHERE "activityId" = ${Activity:sqlstring})) AS "Elapsed", 1609.344 / coalesce(enhanced_speed, speed) AS "Pace"
FROM garmin.fit_record
WHERE "activityId" = ${Activity:sqlstring} AND coalesce(enhanced_speed, speed) > 0.894
ORDER BY "timestamp"

panels.title: Pace (min/mi)

list.definition:
SELECT to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || name || coalesce(' (' || nullif(concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN strpos(lower(name), lower(kind)) = 0 THEN kind END, CASE WHEN distance > 0 THEN to_char(distance / 1609.344, 'FM9990.00') || ' mi' END), '') || ')', '') AS __text, id AS __value
FROM (SELECT a."activityId" AS id, a."startTimeGMT" AS start, a."startTimeLocal" AS day, a.distance, CASE WHEN coalesce(a."locationName", '') <> '' AND strpos(lower(coalesce(nullif(a."activityName", ''), 'Untitled')), lower(a."locationName")) = 0 THEN a."locationName" || ' - ' ELSE '' END || coalesce(nullif(a."activityName", ''), 'Untitled') AS name, upper(left(replace(t."typeKey", '_', ' '), 1)) || substr(replace(t."typeKey", '_', ' '), 2) AS kind FROM garmin.activities a LEFT JOIN garmin."activityType" t ON t."typeId" = a."activityType") AS activities
ORDER BY start DESC
